description: Run a curated reference workflow against a KNOWN, bundled spec (stripe, clerk, descope, resend, twilio, and 50+ others) in ONE call — it spins up the sandbox by slug, so you do NOT need import_spec or a sandbox_id first. Use this when exploring the bundled provider contract: call `guide` on their prompt, then call `quickrun` with the returned spec + workflow. To reproduce a failure, pass the `scenario` from guide's matched_bug_pattern.reproduce_with.scenario (e.g. webhook_retries, payment_declined). Returns sandbox_id + flow_run_id — pass BOTH to verify_behavior to inspect the reference behavior — plus a receipt URL. This does not execute or prove the caller's application. For a bug in their project, use find_bugs, fix_bug and prove_fix on that project; do not substitute this reference receipt for an own-code proof. Use run_workflow instead ONLY when you already hold a sandbox_id from import_spec of a custom/private spec.

scenario.description: OPTIONAL failure scenario to reproduce (e.g. webhook_retries, payment_declined). Take it from guide's matched_bug_pattern.reproduce_with.scenario. Omit for the happy path.

spec_slug.description: The bundled spec slug from guide (e.g. 'stripe'). Lowercase.

name: quickrun
